import S2K_DigestBytes
import NBG_WideBytes
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBP_DigestEncode
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder
open AspisR1.S2K
/-- Exact full encoder, all raw limbs; reuses the existing decreasing-loop
induction on the selected cohort rather than re-proving it. -/
theorem result (digest : Array U32 8#usize) :
    atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical digest = ok (DigestBytes.bytes digest) :=
  DigestBytes.exact digest
/-- The same arbitrary pre-state update checked by native NBG_K020. -/
theorem step (digest : Array U32 8#usize) (index : Usize)
    (range : index.val < 8) (output : Array U8 32#usize) :
    atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical_loop.body (DigestTotal.cursor digest index) output =
      ok (.cont
        (DigestTotal.cursor digest (Usize.ofNatCore (index.val+1) (by scalar_tac)),
         output.setSlice! (4*index.val)
           (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes
             (digest.val[index.val]'(by have := digest.property; change digest.val.length=8 at this; omega))).val)) :=
  DigestTotal.body_word digest index range output
#print axioms result
#print axioms step
#print axioms DigestBytes.loop_exact
#print axioms DigestTotal.next_row
#print axioms DigestTotal.exhausted
end NBP_DigestEncode

import Aeneas
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBP_ArrayIndex
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

def slice {N : Usize} (output : Array U8 N) (start stop : Usize) : Slice U8 :=
  ⟨output.val.slice start.val stop.val, by scalar_tac⟩

theorem index_mut {N : Usize} (output : Array U8 N) (start stop : Usize)
    (order : start.val ≤ stop.val) (bound : stop.val ≤ N.val) :
    core.array.Array.index_mut
      (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8))
      output {start,«end»:=stop} =
    ok (slice output start stop,fun s => output.setSlice! start.val s.val) := by
  simp [core.array.Array.index_mut,core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice,
    core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut,core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice.index_mut,
    Array.to_slice,Slice.length,Slice.len,order,bound,output.property,
    Array.from_slice,Aeneas.Std.Array.setSlice!,slice]

theorem copy {W : Usize} (s : Slice U8) (bytes : Array U8 W)
    (width : s.length = W.val) :
    core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s bytes.to_slice = ok bytes.to_slice := by
  simp [core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice,Slice.len,Slice.length,
    Array.to_slice,bytes.property,width]
theorem slice_length {N : Usize} (output : Array U8 N) (start stop : Usize)
    (order : start.val ≤ stop.val) (bound : stop.val ≤ N.val) :
    (slice output start stop).length = stop.val-start.val := by
  simp only [slice,Slice.length,List.slice,List.length_take,List.length_drop,output.property]
  omega

theorem copy_range {N W : Usize} (output : Array U8 N) (start stop : Usize)
    (bytes : Array U8 W) (order : start.val ≤ stop.val) (bound : stop.val ≤ N.val)
    (width : stop.val-start.val = W.val) :
    core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 (slice output start stop) bytes.to_slice =
      ok bytes.to_slice :=
  copy _ bytes ((slice_length output start stop order bound).trans width)

theorem prefix_index {N : Usize} (output : Array U8 N) (stop : Usize) (bound : stop.val ≤ N.val) :
    core.array.Array.index_mut
      (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice U8))
      output {«end»:=stop} =
    ok (slice output 0#usize stop,fun s => output.setSlice! 0 s.val) := by
  simp [core.array.Array.index_mut,core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice,
    core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut,core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice.index_mut,
    Array.to_slice,Slice.length,Slice.len,bound,output.property,
    Array.from_slice,Aeneas.Std.Array.setSlice!,slice]

theorem suffix_index {N : Usize} (output : Array U8 N) (start : Usize) (bound : start.val ≤ N.val) :
    core.array.Array.index_mut
      (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice U8))
      output {start} =
    ok (slice output start N,fun s => output.setSlice! start.val s.val) := by
  simp [core.array.Array.index_mut,core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice,
    core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut,core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice.index_mut,
    Array.to_slice,Slice.length,Slice.len,bound,output.property,
    Array.from_slice,Aeneas.Std.Array.setSlice!,slice,List.slice,List.take_length,List.length_drop]
  apply Subtype.ext
  change output.val.drop start.val = (output.val.drop start.val).take (N.val-start.val)
  have len : (output.val.drop start.val).length = N.val-start.val := by simp [output.property]
  rw [←len,List.take_length]
#print axioms suffix_index

#print axioms slice_length
#print axioms copy_range
#print axioms prefix_index
#print axioms index_mut
#print axioms copy
end NBP_ArrayIndex

import Aeneas
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBP_Store
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP

def store {N W : Usize} (output : Array U8 N) (start stop : Usize)
    (bytes : Array U8 W) : Result (Array U8 N) := do
  let (s,back) ← core.array.Array.index_mut
    (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8))
    output {start,«end»:=stop}
  let src ← lift (Array.to_slice bytes)
  let copied ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s src
  ok (back copied)

theorem exact {N W : Usize} (output : Array U8 N) (start stop : Usize)
    (bytes : Array U8 W) (order : start.val ≤ stop.val) (bound : stop.val ≤ N.val)
    (width : stop.val-start.val = W.val) :
    store output start stop bytes = ok (output.setSlice! start.val bytes.val) := by
  have room : W.val ≤ N.val-start.val := by omega
  simp only [store,core.array.Array.index_mut,core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice,
    core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut,core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice.index_mut,Array.to_slice]
  simp [Slice.length,Slice.len,order,bound,output.property,bytes.property,
    core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice,List.slice,width,Nat.min_eq_left room,
    Array.from_slice,lift]
  rfl

theorem store_then {N W : Usize} {T : Type} (output : Array U8 N) (start stop : Usize)
    (bytes : Array U8 W) (k : Array U8 N → Result T)
    (order : start.val ≤ stop.val) (bound : stop.val ≤ N.val)
    (width : stop.val-start.val = W.val) :
    (do
      let (s,back) ← core.array.Array.index_mut
        (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8))
        output {start,«end»:=stop}
      let src ← lift (Array.to_slice bytes)
      let copied ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s src
      k (back copied)) = k (output.setSlice! start.val bytes.val) := by
  have h := congrArg (fun r => r >>= k) (exact output start stop bytes order bound width)
  cases indexed : core.array.Array.index_mut
      (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8))
      output {start,«end»:=stop} with
  | fail e => simp only [store,indexed,bind_tc_fail] at h ⊢; exact h
  | div => simp only [store,indexed,bind_tc_div] at h ⊢; exact h
  | ok pair =>
    rcases pair with ⟨s,back⟩
    simp only [store,indexed,bind_tc_ok] at h ⊢
    change ((do
      let copied ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s bytes.to_slice
      ok (back copied)) >>= k) = _ at h
    change (do
      let copied ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s bytes.to_slice
      k (back copied)) = _
    cases copied : core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s bytes.to_slice <;>
      simpa only [copied,bind_tc_ok,bind_tc_fail,bind_tc_div] using h
theorem update {N : Usize} (output : Array U8 N) (index : Usize) (value : U8)
    (bound : index.val < N.val) :
    output.update index value = ok (output.set index value) := by
  obtain ⟨out,call,same⟩ := spec_imp_exists
    (Array.update_spec output index value (by simpa only [Array.length,output.property] using bound))
  simpa only [same] using call
#print axioms update
#print axioms exact
#print axioms store_then
#print Array.update
#print Array.setSlice!
end NBP_Store

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBP_DigestDecode
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder NBP_DecodeWord
/-- Source order, including all noncanonical rejections. -/
def decoded (bytes : Array U8 32#usize) :
    core.result.Result (Array U32 8#usize) atomic_statement.AtomicStatementError :=
  if word bytes 0 >= P then .Err .NonCanonicalDigest else
  if word bytes 1 >= P then .Err .NonCanonicalDigest else
  if word bytes 2 >= P then .Err .NonCanonicalDigest else
  if word bytes 3 >= P then .Err .NonCanonicalDigest else
  if word bytes 4 >= P then .Err .NonCanonicalDigest else
  if word bytes 5 >= P then .Err .NonCanonicalDigest else
  if word bytes 6 >= P then .Err .NonCanonicalDigest else
  if word bytes 7 >= P then .Err .NonCanonicalDigest else
  .Ok (NBG_WideBytes.limbs bytes)

theorem result (bytes : Array U8 32#usize) :
    atomic_statement.decode_digest_canonical bytes = ok (decoded bytes) := by
  by_cases h0 : word bytes 0 >= P
  · simpa [decoded,h0,if_pos] using NBP_DecodeWord.reject0 bytes h0
  ·
    by_cases h1 : word bytes 1 >= P
    · simpa [decoded,h0,if_neg,h1,if_pos] using NBP_Decode1.result bytes (lt_of_not_ge h0) h1
    ·
      by_cases h2 : word bytes 2 >= P
      · simpa [decoded,h0,if_neg,h1,if_neg,h2,if_pos] using NBP_Decode2.result bytes (lt_of_not_ge h0) (lt_of_not_ge h1) h2
      ·
        by_cases h3 : word bytes 3 >= P
        · simpa [decoded,h0,if_neg,h1,if_neg,h2,if_neg,h3,if_pos] using NBP_Decode3.result bytes (lt_of_not_ge h0) (lt_of_not_ge h1) (lt_of_not_ge h2) h3
        ·
          by_cases h4 : word bytes 4 >= P
          · simpa [decoded,h0,if_neg,h1,if_neg,h2,if_neg,h3,if_neg,h4,if_pos] using NBP_Decode4.result bytes (lt_of_not_ge h0) (lt_of_not_ge h1) (lt_of_not_ge h2) (lt_of_not_ge h3) h4
          ·
            by_cases h5 : word bytes 5 >= P
            · simpa [decoded,h0,if_neg,h1,if_neg,h2,if_neg,h3,if_neg,h4,if_neg,h5,if_pos] using NBP_Decode5.result bytes (lt_of_not_ge h0) (lt_of_not_ge h1) (lt_of_not_ge h2) (lt_of_not_ge h3) (lt_of_not_ge h4) h5
            ·
              by_cases h6 : word bytes 6 >= P
              · simpa [decoded,h0,if_neg,h1,if_neg,h2,if_neg,h3,if_neg,h4,if_neg,h5,if_neg,h6,if_pos] using NBP_Decode6.result bytes (lt_of_not_ge h0) (lt_of_not_ge h1) (lt_of_not_ge h2) (lt_of_not_ge h3) (lt_of_not_ge h4) (lt_of_not_ge h5) h6
              ·
                by_cases h7 : word bytes 7 >= P
                · simpa [decoded,h0,if_neg,h1,if_neg,h2,if_neg,h3,if_neg,h4,if_neg,h5,if_neg,h6,if_neg,h7,if_pos] using NBP_Decode7.result bytes (lt_of_not_ge h0) (lt_of_not_ge h1) (lt_of_not_ge h2) (lt_of_not_ge h3) (lt_of_not_ge h4) (lt_of_not_ge h5) (lt_of_not_ge h6) h7
                · simpa [decoded,h0,if_neg,h1,if_neg,h2,if_neg,h3,if_neg,h4,if_neg,h5,if_neg,h6,if_neg,h7,if_neg] using NBP_DecodeSuccess.result bytes (lt_of_not_ge h0) (lt_of_not_ge h1) (lt_of_not_ge h2) (lt_of_not_ge h3) (lt_of_not_ge h4) (lt_of_not_ge h5) (lt_of_not_ge h6) (lt_of_not_ge h7)

    simp only [List.length_take,List.length_drop,bytes.property]

      ok (chunk bytes start.val (by omega)) := by
  have room : W.val ≤ N.val-start.val := by omega

    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice.index,Array.to_slice,

  core.num.U32.from_le_bytes (NBP_Read.chunk (W:=4#usize) b 144 (by decide))

  | .Err _ => .Err .NonCanonicalDigest

    | .Err _ => .Err .NonCanonicalDigest

    core.array.TryFromArrayCopySlice.try_from,core.array.TryFromSharedArraySlice.try_from,
    atomic_statement.unwrap_fixed_slice,aspis_core.field.P,
    NBP_DigestDecode.result,NBG_PaymentChecks.common_result,

import NBP_CommonBytes
import NBP_CommonDecode
import NBG_PaymentValidators
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBP_PaymentModel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder
abbrev T := pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1
abbrev W := pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1
abbrev C := pool_v1.payment_relation.CommonPublicV1
abbrev E := pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PaymentStatementFormatError

def transfer_bytes (p : T) : Array U8 216#usize :=
  let o := NBP_CommonBytes.encoded (Array.repeat 216#usize 0#u8)
    pool_v1.payment_relation.POOL_V1_PRIVATE_TRANSFER_STATEMENT_MAGIC .PrivateTransfer
    (NBG_PaymentValidators.tc p)
  let o := o.setSlice! 152 (AspisR1.S2K.DigestBytes.bytes p.recipient_commitment).val
  o.setSlice! 184 (AspisR1.S2K.DigestBytes.bytes p.change_commitment).val

def withdrawal_bytes (p : W) : Array U8 216#usize :=
  let o := NBP_CommonBytes.encoded (Array.repeat 216#usize 0#u8)
    pool_v1.payment_relation.POOL_V1_WITHDRAWAL_STATEMENT_MAGIC .Withdrawal
    (NBG_PaymentValidators.wc p)
  let o := o.setSlice! 148 (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes p.amount).val
  let o := o.setSlice! 152 p.destination_token_account.val
  o.setSlice! 184 (AspisR1.S2K.DigestBytes.bytes p.change_commitment).val

def transfer_encoded (p : T) : core.result.Result (Array U8 216#usize) E :=
  match NBG_PaymentValidators.transfer p with
  | .Err e => .Err e | .Ok () => .Ok (transfer_bytes p)
def withdrawal_encoded (p : W) : core.result.Result (Array U8 216#usize) E :=
  match NBG_PaymentValidators.withdrawal p with
  | .Err e => .Err e | .Ok () => .Ok (withdrawal_bytes p)

def transfer_public (c : C) (r z : Array U32 8#usize) : T :=
  ⟨c.pool,c.deployment_domain,c.anchor_sequence,c.anchor_root,c.nullifier,c.asset_id,r,z⟩
def withdrawal_public (c : C) (b : Array U8 216#usize) (z : Array U32 8#usize) : W :=
  ⟨c.pool,c.deployment_domain,c.anchor_sequence,c.anchor_root,c.nullifier,c.asset_id,
    core.num.U32.from_le_bytes (NBP_Read.chunk b 148 (by decide)),
    NBP_Read.chunk b 152 (by decide),z⟩

def transfer_decoded (b : Array U8 216#usize) : core.result.Result T E :=
  match NBG_Header.expected b pool_v1.payment_relation.POOL_V1_PRIVATE_TRANSFER_STATEMENT_MAGIC .PrivateTransfer with
  | .Err e => .Err e
  | .Ok () =>
    if (b.val.drop 148).take 4 ≠ List.replicate 4 0#u8 then .Err .NonZeroReserved else
    match NBP_CommonDecode.decoded b with
    | .Err e => .Err e
    | .Ok c =>
      match NBP_DigestDecode.decoded (NBP_Read.chunk b 152 (by decide)) with
      | .Err _ => .Err .NonCanonicalDigest
      | .Ok r =>
        match NBP_DigestDecode.decoded (NBP_Read.chunk b 184 (by decide)) with
        | .Err _ => .Err .NonCanonicalDigest
        | .Ok z =>
          let p := transfer_public c r z
          match NBG_PaymentValidators.transfer p with
          | .Err e => .Err e | .Ok () => .Ok p

def withdrawal_decoded (b : Array U8 216#usize) : core.result.Result W E :=
  match NBG_Header.expected b pool_v1.payment_relation.POOL_V1_WITHDRAWAL_STATEMENT_MAGIC .Withdrawal with
  | .Err e => .Err e
  | .Ok () =>
    match NBP_CommonDecode.decoded b with
    | .Err e => .Err e
    | .Ok c =>
      match NBP_DigestDecode.decoded (NBP_Read.chunk b 184 (by decide)) with
      | .Err _ => .Err .NonCanonicalDigest
      | .Ok z =>
        let p := withdrawal_public c b z
        match NBG_PaymentValidators.withdrawal p with
        | .Err e => .Err e | .Ok () => .Ok p
end NBP_PaymentModel
